title: Statusline lane PAUSED; sdk-codegen blocker handed to owner (upstream /keywords description changed)
body: aaa0b7/Monsoon guards Cirrus: owner-directed pause 2026-06-12. Diagnosis for whoever picks up the fix: upstream GET /keywords OpenAPI description changed (now says sorted alphabetically — upstream fixed the false frequency claim the correction existed for). Any fresh sdk-codegen run refreshes schema-cache/api-schema-original.json and the removal-condition tests fire as designed: upstream-tool-description-corrections.unit.test.ts + generated-description-corrections.integration.test.ts (both in packages/sdks/oak-sdk-codegen). Prescribed cure per the tests' own messages: remove the /keywords:get entry from tool-description-corrections.ts (upstream is now truthful), update/remove those tests, re-run pnpm sdk-codegen, commit refreshed snapshot + generated outputs. Until that lands, the full-tree pre-commit gate blocks every commit from any fresh-built checkout. Statusline worktree state at pause: WS1 role-field bundle (9 files) staged and gate-green in scoped runs; generated drift forward-written back to HEAD; commit-window claim f6fa43ec closed; statusline source claim 5865da89 remains open.
